meta.title: Fix inference OOM by streaming dataset
meta.body_summary: Avoid OOM during inference by streaming input datasets in batches and writing results incrementally instead of loading entire datasets into memory.

perf_labels.notes: OpenAI_Codex streamed dataset to avoid OOM; BabyChouSr approved but asked for parquet support; partial fix added parquet input but not output; tests missing; auto-closed after inactivity.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 170 changed lines across 4 files, this is a small-to-medium edit by absolute volume, mostly concentrated in inference.py (77 lines). It fits a targeted performance fix that was closed due to incomplete parquet support and subsequent inactivity.

review_details.concern_detail: Reviewer noted that the streaming approach only handles JSON files; parquet output requires a different write path. Also, tests are needed for this codepath.
review_details.performance_claim: Streaming inference dataset avoids OOM by not loading entire dataset into memory.
review_details.rejection_signals: Ambiguous: approved with condition but incomplete; bot closed due to inactivity after 3 months.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Streaming implementation for JSON files worked, but lack of parquet output support and missing tests prevented merge; Agent failed to cover all file formats required by the codebase.

detection_detail.code_reading: BabyChouSr reviewed the diff and noted that iter_dataset_batches handling for parquet should use fsspec.open, and that output writing only works for JSON files; dlwh commented on missing tests.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No OOM benchmark or profiling; only narrative claims.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: PR was closed by bot after 3 months of inactivity following partial fix and review comments.

core_change_summary.description: Refactored process_file_with_quality_classifier to stream data in batches from iter_dataset_batches, writing results incrementally with fsspec.open for JSON formats; added parquet input handling (reading) but output remains JSON-only.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Test files were added but not fully fleshed out; executor.py changes were from merge.
change_trajectory: Initial commit: replaced read_dataset and write_dataset with streaming iter_dataset_batches and line-by-line writes for JSON files.
parquet file fix: added parquet reading support in iter_dataset_batches via fsspec.open, and added compression detection for output.
wip tests: added a test file tests/processing/classification/test_inference.py with initial pytest test.
Merge main: resolved merge conflicts bringing in unrelated changes.

review_signals.summary: Suggested using fsspec.open for consistency in parquet reading.
Output writing only supports JSON files; parquet output requires a fallback to write_dataset.
Requested tests for the streaming codepath.
review_signals.action_taken: WIP tests commit added, but not completed.

collaboration_trajectory: PR opened by dlwh with initial streaming implementation.
Same day maintainer BabyChouSr reviewed, suggested fsspec.open usage, and noted missing parquet output support; approved with the condition.
nikil-ravi added parquet reading support and a WIP test within hours.
Reviewer dlwh commented that tests are needed for the new codepath.
No further activity; bot closed after 3 months of inactivity.
